create_label_smoothed_cross_entropy_crit: create a label smoothed cross entropy criterion with configurable smoothing epsilon for NLL loss regularization
compute_label_smoothed_loss: compute label smoothed cross entropy loss combining NLL loss and uniform distribution smooth loss
forward_label_smoothed_criterion: forward pass through the criterion to compute loss, sample size, and logging outputs for a model sample
aggregate_logging_outputs: aggregate logging outputs from data parallel training into averaged loss, nll_loss, token and sentence counts
register_label_smoothed_criterion: register the label smoothed cross entropy criterion with the fairseq criterion registry via decorator
